agreements: The proposal asks the right bounded mechanism question: whether one aligned held-out collision-twin pair can carry a life-specific public connection through target-absent prompted memory growth, bounded text access, fresh composition, and conditional per-life adapter reads without an exact in-loop verifier.

The broad stage order is worth preserving: repair and freeze public projection on development data, build independent per-life M0 states, fork literal zero-return and matched own/distractor branches, compile immutable supported content, run fresh bounded text thinkers, conditionally fit exactly two adapters, and stop at a human terminal.

The current package is not ready for ratification or implementation because materially different implementations can expose different bytes, admit different rows, choose different corpora, execute different interventions, and count different work while appearing conformant.
M0 sufficiency, useful goal-return allocation, text reconstruction, adapter accessibility, and life binding are distinct outcomes and must not be collapsed into one green pipeline label.
THINK0 receives a designer-specified source, target, and relation frontier, so any positive result is strongly scaffolded prompted agenda routing rather than autonomous missing-dependency discovery.

A structured text reader and exposure-expanded adapter-training file need not be literally byte-identical; the valid same-corpus invariant is derivation from one content-addressed eligible-row, provenance, registered-view, and touch manifest without semantic changes.

Invalid preconditions and infrastructure failures must be separated from valid scientific stage failures, and a valid red stage localizes only an observed failure surface with unresolved within-stage causes.

Replication, additional seeds or skins, beyond-context lifetimes, RML, learned LOOP control, adapter rank or model pyramids, broad baseline saturation, population estimates, whole-corpus or longitudinal durability, autonomous-discovery claims, and Paper-1 headline claims are deferred rather than prerequisites for this one-pair canary.

No adjudicator recommendation, reviewer agreement, or future canary result can auto-ratify the change, authorize implementation or model/GPU work, launch a successor study, or promote a scientific claim.

disagreements.issue: Whether the current prompts, generic schemas, and narrative uniquely define the recurrent row lifecycle, canonical corpus, and backend-neutral reader needed for a scientifically comparable implementation.

positions.position: The exact prompt and schema files plus the stated supported-only compiler and one-row reader are sufficient to proceed after ordinary preflight tests.

Phase legality, kind-specific tuple semantics, append-only status transitions, transitive provenance, canonical corpus bytes, query matching, conflict behavior, and immutable read receipts remain material and unbound.
Independent support and depth also require stronger operational definitions, but the one-pair canary does not need a general orchestration platform or a mechanical proof checker.

resolution.rationale: The systems objection is correct at the level needed to make the canary reproducible, and the critique correctly narrows the repair. These semantics decide what evidence becomes supported memory, what the thinker can retrieve, and what exact content reaches an adapter; leaving them to implementation discretion would change the experiment. A small canary-specific contract is sufficient.
resolution.selected_position: Require a newly hash-bound canary revision with phase-specific operation legality, kind-specific row and query tables, local alias namespaces, one append-only reducer, transitive public-provenance accounting, one canonical compiler, and one backend-neutral reader/receipt contract. Do not build a general control-plane framework or exact semantic proof engine.
resolution.required_change: Bind CREATE, REINFORCE, SUPERSEDE, PASS, QUERY, REASON, BACKTRACK, REQUEST_DREAM, COMMIT, and DEFER legality by phase; define witnessed admission, PROVISIONAL/SUPPORTED/CONTRADICTED/SUPERSEDED transitions including null replacement and conflicts; define canonical ids, serialization, ordering, deduplication, four views, touch plan, line endings, query matching, all-null and repeated-scan rejection, deterministic NOT_FOUND/CONFLICT behavior, and immutable one-row receipts. Malformed or forbidden operations consume their frozen opportunity without semantic retry.

disagreements.issue: Whether the visibility matrix and fresh-session language adequately enforce public-only, bounded, life-isolated model requests and evaluator noninterference.

positions.position: The matrix, public-projection mutation test, bounded row counts, and fresh sessions express the intended information firewall.

Known private ratio and distractor-field leaks plus retained chat, KV, RNG, index, cache, filename, namespace, focus, query-echo, and evaluator channels can violate the firewall unless exact serialized requests and resets are bound.

resolution.rationale: The intended firewall is scientifically appropriate but not yet an executable invariant. Visibility is defined by actual provider-visible bytes and retained state, not by the source object or prompt admonition alone. The minimum repair is explicit projection, stateless request reconstruction, taint exclusion, and auditable reset/noninterference receipts.
resolution.selected_position: Adopt explicit per-episode-kind and THINK0-probe allowlists; hash allowed source state, canonical messages, provider configuration, and private audit metadata separately; use stateless per-operation requests or an exact equivalent retained-state receipt; and keep the evaluator write-denied except for no orchestration result edge because transport selection is fixed by P1C_CONS_R03_FIXED_M1_TRANSPORT.
resolution.required_change: Remove internal ratios, unrendered canonical identifiers, matched-distractor endpoints, latent/split/pair fields, expected answers, proofs, scorer data, arm/life/donor labels, filenames, and output namespaces from model-visible bytes unless explicitly public. Bind reset inventories for every life, phase, arm, reader, workspace, retrieval index, RNG, cache, and adapter mount. Add focus/query laundering and evaluator-noninterference fixtures proving that selection metadata, THINK0 scratch, query echoes, truth, proof, and scores cannot alter durable rows, corpus bytes, retries, training inputs, or later cognition.

disagreements.issue: Whether held-out text outcomes may select M0 or OWN M1 for the corpus later transported through adapters.

positions.position: A predeclared earliest-pass rule may choose M0 when it passes and otherwise OWN M1, preventing discretionary post hoc choice.
The candidates can remain result-blind if both are sealed before goal reveal and a deterministic post-text selector receives only a registered pass bit.
Any held-out outcome-dependent choice is an adaptive two-candidate screen; a prospectively fixed transport stage, preferably OWN M1, gives cleaner one-pair decision value.

resolution.rationale: A one-bit selector would repair the systems contradiction but retain the scientific adaptivity. The minimum coherent one-pair design is simpler: prospectively fix OWN M1 independently for each life as the text pipeline and adapter transport corpus, while retaining M0 and DIST only as separately reported construction and return-attribution controls. This removes every evaluator-result edge into corpus or training selection.
resolution.selected_position: Fix the OWN M1 corpus before held-out goal reveal as the sole credited text-pipeline and conditional adapter-transport corpus. Report T-M0 and T-DIST separately. Do not choose between M0 and M1 from seed-5 correctness or path outcomes.
resolution.required_change: Replace every earliest-passing M0-or-OWN rule in the graph, loop, visibility, tests, spec, configuration, and claims. Seal M0, OWN M1, and DIST M1 independently; run their registered text conditions; define pipeline existence on the prospectively fixed OWN M1 condition; use the corresponding other twin's OWN M1 for T-TWIN and the two OWN M1 manifests for adapter fitting and L-TWIN. M0 success can support target-absent sufficiency only, and useful return credit still requires OWN paired success plus M0 and DIST paired failure under P1C_CONS_R06_SUPPORT_DEPTH_AND_RETURN_CREDIT.

disagreements.issue: Whether offline citation edits and generic degradation under a twin swap are sufficient for path-use and life-binding claims.

positions.position: Offline decisive-row masking and twin substitution that removes paired success can establish path use and life binding.

Behavioral counterfactuals require fresh bounded THINK1 runs under modified readers, same-stage donor artifacts, clean resets, counted work, and content-specific donor predictions; an edited trace or nonspecific degradation is inadequate.

resolution.rationale: The stronger model-facing definition is necessary because a fresh thinker may recover an alternate path, and a swap may degrade for reasons unrelated to donor content. Only a small registered set is required for this canary: one decisive-row mask and one same-stage twin substitution per credited substrate and member, plus the semantic-parent intervention in P1C_CONS_R06_SUPPORT_DEPTH_AND_RETURN_CREDIT when multi-hop or return credit is sought.
resolution.selected_position: Run all claimed masking and twin substitutions as fresh deterministic THINK1 conditions with the modified backend, identical budgets, hidden arm/donor identity, and sealed outputs. A donor swap must return the donor-valid decisive atom and yield the predeclared donor-valid opposite token for each recipient; generic loss, change, or defer is reported but earns no life-binding credit.
resolution.required_change: Add an explicit swap-only derived visibility state for OTHER_LIFE_MEMORY at THINK1, isolated same-stage donor mounts, fresh reset receipts, frozen decoding seeds, immutable read receipts, and separate call/read accounting. Use only OWN M1 versus the other twin's OWN M1 for the credited text and adapter swaps. Reword offline evaluation as scoring of already sealed intervention outputs, not as the intervention itself.

disagreements.issue: Whether target embargo and query restrictions prevent durable memory from directly storing the animal-at-target answer or complete final proof.

positions.position: Target-blind prompts and forbidden final-answer queries leave role transfer, effect conditioning, arithmetic, and workshop mapping to THINK1.
TRANSFERRED_VALUE and free-form fields can encode an answer-equivalent animal-at-target tuple or complete proof before the goal is shown, bypassing the claimed fresh composition.
Finite kind-specific ontology and query rules must reject stored and queried answer-equivalent structures without semantic guesswork.

resolution.rationale: The storage path is a real shortcut and cannot be fixed by reader restrictions alone. Removing the broad TRANSFERRED_VALUE kind is the smallest auditable repair for this canary and avoids introducing a truth-aware cognitive verifier.
resolution.selected_position: Remove TRANSFERRED_VALUE from the one-pair canary's writable and corpus-eligible ontology, and use a frozen goal-independent structural denylist for direct animal-at-location target state, final public token, complete-proof tuple, and aliased equivalents.
resolution.required_change: Revise the row schema, prompt, phase/kind tables, compiler eligibility, and adversarial tests so forbidden stored or queried encodings fail closed and consume the operation without repair. The rule may inspect public tuple shape and registered alias namespace only; hidden correctness, target answer, proof scorer, and offline outcomes must remain unavailable in-loop.

disagreements.issue: What is minimally required to call a row independently supported, multi-hop, and causally added by the goal-return branch.

positions.position: A new citation handle can reinforce a row, and computed depth of at least two with a prior semantic citation plus downstream masking is sufficient for multi-hop return credit.
Support must be independent over transitive public provenance, while citation ancestry alone can be ornamental and does not show that the semantic parent changed row formation or final use.

Require lineage-disjoint support for admission and one registered parent removal or substitution replay for a multi-hop or return-construction claim, but do not require a mechanical proof checker for every row.

resolution.rationale: Lineage-disjoint support is necessary for corpus integrity. A bounded parent counterfactual is also necessary only for the specific row on which multi-hop or return credit rests. Other rows may retain syntactic depth labels without causal multi-hop interpretation.
resolution.selected_position: Compute support over transitive public-event provenance and prohibit a descendant or paraphrase of the creation lineage from independently reinforcing it. For the one credited depth-2 OWN delta, predeclare one fresh parent-removal or matched-parent-substitution replay with a content-specific predicted row/trace and final-decision change.
resolution.required_change: Bind provenance-closure calculation and reducer checks; add the registered semantic-parent intervention to the frozen intervention ledger; require the correct requested OWN delta to be absent from M0 and DIST, OWN to pass paired text behavior, M0 and DIST to fail paired behavior, and the parent intervention plus decisive-row masking to change the sealed output as predicted. If the parent intervention is not run or misses, report syntactic depth only and award no multi-hop or return-construction credit.

disagreements.issue: How prospective the development headroom, shortcut, and OWN-versus-DIST matching rules must be for a one-pair canary.

positions.position: Development seeds 0--2, existing world tests, complete public-feature shortcut gates, and type/call/seed/view-matched DIST provide adequate preflight and extra-compute control.

The package does not bind prompt-development stopping, all-pair aggregation, numerical thresholds for all 31 predictors, necessary-edge behavior, or observable evidence and retrieval difficulty for the distractor.
Exact population balance or matching every latent difficulty property would overengineer a single-pair canary; a frozen structurally eligible distractor and exact development gate suffice.

resolution.rationale: The missing prospective rules directly govern whether seed 5 may be exposed and whether DIST is a meaningful compute control. They must be fixed, but only on observable canary-relevant dimensions; population power and exhaustive latent matching are deferred.
resolution.selected_position: Before any held-out exposure, freeze a finite prompt-development attempt budget and stopping rule, require GOLD_TEXT success on every registered seed-0--2 twin pair with necessary-edge and donor-token interventions, bind each of the 31 public-feature predictors and its numerical threshold plus aggregate pass rule, and select one distractor using observable evidence availability, temporal window, and candidate-neighborhood size in addition to type, calls, seed, and view count.
resolution.required_change: Add exact development manifests, thresholds, aggregation, failure behavior, and a post-development byte-freeze receipt. Bind the single distractor identity and its measurable matching receipts before seed 5 is model-visible. Continue to report NO_MEMORY, RAW_RAG, and GOLD_OPEN_LOOP, but do not turn this canary into the later full baseline, multi-seed, or multi-skin study.

disagreements.issue: What same-corpus equality and a 0.90 adapter fidelity result can validly mean across structured text reads and exposure-expanded training input.

positions.position: Exact text/LoRA corpus equality and path-local fidelity of at least 0.90 show that the identical useful corpus survived per-life parametric installation.
Equality should bind a shared content-addressed semantic/view/touch manifest, with backend-specific delivery derived from it; delivery byte streams need not be identical.

The probe set, cues, denominator, outputs, error treatment, truncation, and exposure must be frozen before fitting, and success supports immediate path-local accessibility only, not whole-corpus preservation or durability.

resolution.rationale: The systems definition is the reproducible cross-substrate invariant and the scientific claim restriction matches the small registered probe. Requiring literal delivery-byte equality or adding whole-corpus and longitudinal studies would be conceptually wrong or out of scope.
resolution.selected_position: Use one canonical OWN M1 per-life manifest of eligible rows, provenance, registered views, and touch plan, then derive text-reader and adapter-training delivery without semantic changes. Freeze all decisive and matched-distractor probe rows, cue strings, exact outputs, denominator, error scoring, tokenizer limits, no-truncation rule, and touch-by-epoch exposure before either adapter fit. Interpret a passing threshold only as immediate path-local accessibility under those cues.
resolution.required_change: Revise same-corpus language, manifests, hashes, compiler tests, adapter derivation receipts, fidelity test, and claim linter. Count NOT_FOUND, CONFLICT, malformed, or truncated reads under a frozen fail rule; include all fidelity calls in the separate 7B ledger; train exactly one adapter per OWN M1 twin and no additional rank, seed, model, or retry variants.

disagreements.issue: How model/GPU transitions, complete work accounting, and infrastructure failures must be represented when prerequisite evidence is itself generated in ordered model stages.

positions.position: Tests marked required_before gpu_run and aggregate 352/400 generation and 48-read ceilings express a bounded staged workflow.
An undifferentiated gpu_run gate is cyclic or bypassable, and the totals omit development, model-facing path interventions, fidelity probes, failures, and tokenizer/truncation checks.
Invalid, malformed, deferred, exhausted, provider-failed, or contaminated cells must never be silently rerun or counted as a scientific negative.

resolution.rationale: The evidence stages require distinct monotone authority transitions, and scientific interpretation requires full accounting and validity classification. These are bounded canary controls, not authorization to run any stage now.
resolution.selected_position: Replace gpu_run with separately reviewed DEV_GOLD, HELDOUT_TEXT, and CONDITIONAL_LORA transition tokens whose predecessor artifacts and hashes are exact. Publish separate ceilings and ledgers for development generations, held-out dream/think core calls, model-facing interventions, text reads, online adapter reads, fixed fidelity probes, tokenizer checks, provider/infrastructure failures, and exactly two fits.
resolution.required_change: Bind a monotone authority state machine and fail forbidden or out-of-order transitions before any model request. Define retry and failure consumption prospectively, perform tokenizer-exact preflight, seal partial artifacts, and classify each terminal as INVALID_PRECONDITION, INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE, or a valid stage disposition. Require fresh independent reviewer approval and a separate advocate artifact for each transition, with reviewer rejection supreme and no automatic repair or successor.

disagreements.issue: What positive and negative claims the repaired one-pair canary can support, and which desirable extensions are mandatory now.

positions.position: The canary can provide end-to-end existence or localize failure to a named organ while preserving a non-headline claim firewall.
Positive language must disclose strong frontier and proof scaffolding and path-local adapter access; a first red composite stage identifies a failure surface, not a uniquely broken organ.

The minimum exact one-pair contracts are mandatory, while replication, RML, LOOP training, rank/model sweeps, population estimates, full later baselines, and durability studies should constrain claims and be deferred rather than delay the canary.

resolution.rationale: Both claim corrections are necessary for scientific honesty, while the listed extensions answer different questions and would turn a canary into a confirmatory program. The rework must repair internal validity, not expand scientific ambition.
resolution.selected_position: Limit positive language to one-pair, strongly scaffolded prompted construction/use and, if it passes, immediate path-local accessibility through exactly two per-life adapters. Limit negative language to a valid observed stage failure with explicit within-stage alternatives. Keep all population, beyond-context, superiority, autonomous-discovery, learned-control, active-improvement, durability, flywheel, replication, RML, LOOP-adapter, rank-pyramid, and headline claims forbidden.
resolution.required_change: Rename P1C_C_NEGATIVE_LOCALIZATION to stage-level failure-surface localization; add INVALID_PRECONDITION, INVALID_INFRASTRUCTURE, and VALID_STAGE_FAILURE dispositions; revise success text to disclose the exact THINK0 frontier and THINK1 proof scaffold; lint every artifact and terminal report for canary-only language; stop unconditionally at human interpretation without launching replication or any deferred architecture.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. Row admission, lifecycle, compiler, and reader semantics change the actual evidence and are not safely left to implementation discretion. The repair is limited to small canary-specific tables, reducers, serializers, and receipts.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Perform the exact executable-contract rework in P1C_CONS_R01_EXECUTABLE_CONTRACTS before a new consensus; do not implement the current package.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. Known ratio and probe-field leaks plus unspecified retained state violate the model-facing boundary even if the narrative matrix is correct in intent.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind per-kind projection, exact serialized surfaces, stateless request/reset receipts, taint exclusion, and evaluator noninterference as specified in P1C_CONS_R02_VISIBILITY_AND_ISOLATION.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. A predeclared earliest-pass order still adapts the sole held-out transport corpus to hidden-truth outcomes and contradicts the stated result firewall.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Prospectively fix OWN M1 as the only credited text and adapter transport corpus, with M0 and DIST retained solely as separately reported controls.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. Offline edits cannot establish counterfactual thinker behavior, and generic swap degradation does not attribute behavior to donor life content.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Run the bounded masked and same-stage donor conditions as fresh, counted, reset THINK1 calls with content-specific predicted atoms and tokens.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. The broad TRANSFERRED_VALUE kind permits direct storage of what THINK1 is supposed to compose.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Remove TRANSFERRED_VALUE for this canary and bind a goal-independent structural exclusion for direct target-state, final-token, complete-proof, and alias-equivalent storage and queries.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Material. Handle novelty can self-reinforce from one event lineage, and citation depth can be ornamental. The stronger requirement applies narrowly to corpus support and the single credited multi-hop return row.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use transitive provenance-lineage independence for support and one registered content-specific semantic-parent intervention for multi-hop or return-construction credit.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. These rules control held-out release and OWN-versus-DIST attribution and therefore must be prospectively numerical and observable, without requiring population-scale balance.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind prompt attempt/stopping, all-development-pair aggregation, 31 predictor thresholds and aggregate rule, necessary-edge/donor predictions, and one observable structurally matched distractor before seed 5 exposure.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Material. Cross-substrate equality belongs at the shared semantic/view/touch manifest, and the small frozen probe supports immediate path-local accessibility only.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind canonical manifests, backend derivations, pre-fit probe identities/cues/outputs/error rules, no truncation, exact exposure, and path-local claim language.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Blocking. The current prerequisite label is cyclic or bypassable and the aggregate ceilings omit required evidence-generating work.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Bind three ordered reviewed authority tokens and complete categorized, tokenizer-exact ledgers with frozen failure and retry behavior; no token or work is authorized by this consensus.

concern_dispositions.rationale: Material. A composite red stage is not proof that a unique organ is intrinsically broken, and invalid infrastructure is not a scientific negative.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Use the three-way validity taxonomy, stage-level failure-surface language, listed within-stage alternatives, and strict canary-only positive and negative claim linting.

concern_dispositions.rationale: The scope judgment is correct: the mandatory repairs establish internal coherence for one pair; the larger studies answer later reliability, comparison, learning, scale, and durability questions.
concern_dispositions.required_change: Record replication, additional seeds/skins, beyond-context tasks, full later baselines, RML, LOOP-adapter work, rank/model sweeps, population estimation, and whole-corpus or longitudinal durability as forbidden/deferred, not as rework prerequisites.

upstream_disagreement_dispositions.rationale: The sole held-out pair must not select its own transport stage. The adjudication chooses the interpretation's preferred prospectively fixed OWN M1 corpus and reports M0 separately.
Target embargo does not prevent answer-equivalent storage. Removing TRANSFERRED_VALUE and adding a goal-independent structural exclusion is the smallest auditable remedy.
Generic degradation is nonspecific. Same-stage donor substitution must produce the registered donor-valid decisive atom and token in fresh model-facing runs.
Citation ancestry may be ornamental. Multi-hop or return-construction credit requires the one bounded semantic-parent intervention, while untested rows may be labeled syntactically deep only.
A valid red cell identifies a stage-level failure surface with unresolved internal alternatives, not a uniquely incapable organ.
The registered probe can establish immediate path-local accessibility only, not whole-corpus preservation or durability.
The operational probe supplies the exact frontier, so success is strongly scaffolded prompted agenda routing and not autonomous dependency discovery.
The current schemas and prose permit material semantic variation. A small newly bound executable contract is required before implementation, without constructing a general framework.
T-TWIN and L-TWIN are model-facing cross-life reads and need an explicit swap-only derived visibility edge with donor identity hidden.
Deleting a citation after commitment does not measure behavior under a changed backend. Fresh registered masking runs are required.

The diagnosis that earliest-pass selection is outcome-dependent is accepted. The proposed pass-bit selector would make execution coherent but retain scientific adaptivity, so this adjudication instead removes the selector and prospectively fixes OWN M1.
Development, held-out text, and conditional adapter evidence require distinct monotone authority transitions and reviews.
The published totals omit required development, intervention, probe, truncation, and failure categories; separate exact ledgers are mandatory.
Phase-long hidden state can violate one-record and six-row bounds. Stateless per-operation reconstruction or an exact equivalent receipt is required.
Precondition and infrastructure invalidity must be separated from a valid stage failure before any scientific localization language is used.

acceptance_test_dispositions.rationale: Retain exact scope, hashes, forbidden routes, and human termination; replace earliest-pass selection and undifferentiated GPU gating with prospective OWN M1 transport, three monotone reviewed authority tokens, exact predecessor hashes, partial-failure sealing, and explicit invalidity dispositions.

Retain public-only mutation testing and add exact per-kind and THINK0-probe allowlists, canonical provider messages/configuration, canonical-id and distractor-field attacks, private audit-surface separation, focus/query laundering, and evaluator noninterference.

Retain world, shortcut, and gold ceilings; bind the prompt-development attempt/stopping rule, success on every seed-0--2 twin pair, all 31 predictor thresholds and aggregate rule, fresh necessary-edge/donor-token interventions, and a post-development byte freeze before seed 5.

Retain exact prefix and branch counts, literal zero return, false-supported persistence, and copy-on-write isolation; add the complete transition table, witnessed status, null replacement, transitive provenance-lineage independence, malformed-call consumption, per-twin independent prefixes, stateless requests, and observable distractor matching.

Retain strict nonrepair and one-row reads; add phase-specific operation legality, kind-specific ontology, local aliases, removal of TRANSFERRED_VALUE, stored/query answer-equivalent attacks, all-null and repeated-scan rejection, canonical match/order/CONFLICT semantics, immutable receipts, and selection-metadata laundering tests.

Retain deterministic supported non-superseded compilation and clean lives; define equality at the canonical eligible-row/provenance/view/touch manifest, bind exact serialization/dedup/conflict/backend derivation and reset receipts, preserve audit-only mutation invariance, and require same-stage OWN M1 donor mounts.

Replace outcome-selected earliest pass with prospective OWN M1 pipeline credit; report M0 and DIST separately; run fresh counted decisive-row mask, same-stage donor, and claimed semantic-parent interventions; require donor-valid atoms/tokens, lineage-disjoint support, correct OWN-only delta, and the original M0/DIST failures for return credit.

Retain exactly two rank-64 fits conditional on a valid fixed-OWN-M1 text pass; freeze probe rows, cues, outputs, denominator, error/truncation and exposure rules before fitting; bind adapter derivation to the same manifest; run fresh own and same-stage donor conditions; and claim immediate path-local accessibility only.

Retain reviewer supremacy, separate advocate, hash closure, claim linting, and human stop; require stage-specific review tokens, complete categorized ledgers, reset/visibility/evaluator receipts, fixed-corpus and manifest proofs, three-way validity taxonomy, partial-failure sealing, and no automatic repair or successor.

Does Rohin accept that any future green result is limited to strongly scaffolded one-pair construction/use and immediate path-local adapter accessibility, while any valid red result localizes only a stage-level failure surface?

Does Rohin confirm that RML, learned LOOP or LOOP-adapter work, rank/model pyramids, replication, additional seeds/skins, beyond-context studies, full baseline saturation, durability studies, autonomous-discovery claims, and all headline claims remain outside this repair and require separate future deliberation?
